title: Learning app
name: Quillnest
ask: Create a brand identity for Quillnest, the writing app in this folder.
owner: Owner preferences: encouraging and a little bold, for 13–17 year-olds, never childish or school-like. No owls, no pencils or quills drawn literally, no lightbulbs, no speech bubbles. App icon for iOS and Android plus a web version.
